title: Bind manifest, LLVM IR, native object, registration sidecars, and claim sidecars into one truth gate

mode_matrix.name: native-manifest-object-ir-truth-gate
abi_requirements: Objc3ManifestObjectIrTruthGateSummary emits contract objc3c.manifest.object.ir.truth.gate.v1 above the existing runtime metadata emission and object emission closeout gates

Objc3IREmitter publishes manifest_object_ir_truth_gate in module.ll and names module.manifest.json, module.ll, module.obj, module.runtime-registration-descriptor.json, module.runtime-registration-manifest.json, and module.objc3-conformance-report.json as bound artifacts

The truth-gate report regenerates two positive compiler runs and verifies deterministic hashes for manifest, IR, object, registration, runtime metadata, discovery/linker, and conformance publication artifacts
The native object inspected with llvm-readobj/llvm-objdump contains the same objc3.runtime.* sections and __objc3_* aggregate symbols that the IR and manifest advertise
Versioned conformance and runtime capability sidecars are ready and remain bound to the same generated artifact set
runtime_requirements: module.obj contains objc3.runtime.image_info, class/protocol/category/property/ivar descriptor sections, selector/string pools, discovery root, linker anchor, image root, and registration descriptor sections
module.obj contains __objc3_sec_* aggregate symbols, runtime discovery/link anchors, registration table, image root, registration descriptor, and bootstrap registration references

abi_field_stability.stability_property: The emitted truth-gate contract id must remain objc3c.manifest.object.ir.truth.gate.v1 until an intentional version bump
Manifest, IR, object, registration, runtime metadata, discovery/linker, conformance, and release-candidate sidecars must be regenerated together
